verdict.rationale: Framer's Server API is described as letting you 'automate publishing' and 'bring Framer into your product,' which implies some programmatic/headless automation capability, but there is no documentation of a CLI, headless build mode, or CI pipeline integration—everything else (AI agent, plugins, branching) is editor-centric and interactive rather than scriptable in CI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless execution docs, CLI tooling, automated build/test pipeline support, and independent confirmation of Server API usage in CI contexts.
